name: windows-shell-safety
description: Run Azure CLI and other native commands on Windows without losing pipes, quotes, JSON, or special characters to cmd.exe, with a pre-execution lint.

interface.shortDescription: Windows-safe az, JSON, and pipe execution
interface.longDescription: Prescriptive rules, a pre-execution lint, and a PowerShell 7 helper that keep Azure CLI (az.cmd) and other native commands on Windows from losing pipes, quotes, inline JSON, and non-ASCII text to cmd.exe, nested -Command strings, and console encoding.
defaultPrompt: Check this az command before I run it on Windows.
Rewrite this Azure CLI call so the JSON body survives PowerShell and cmd.exe.
Why does my --query with a pipe fail on Windows?
